summary: Learn enterprise policy management with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, control mapping, and workflow tools. Build practical governance outputs in 5 days.
lede: Enterprise policy management governs how policies are drafted, approved, published, reviewed, and retired across an organization. For professionals who manage, review, enforce, or audit policies, this course provides practical methods to build policy inventories, map policies to controls, manage exceptions and review cycles, and prepare compliance dashboards and audit evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who manage, review, enforce, or audit enterprise policies across functions. It suits you if you work where policy decisions affect control, compliance, records management, or operational consistency.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and a basic working knowledge of policy documents, approval flows, and compliance responsibilities. You should also be prepared to review sample policies, complete template-based exercises, and use spreadsheet or document-management tools during the workshop.
